title: Turquoise Kitchen Set
description: A reference-dependent series: one hero shot of a 1958-imagined future kitchen, followed by three angle and moment variations preserving the same room, appliances, and color palette.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the full turquoise atomic kitchen wide shot. Images 02-04 depend on 01 as --ref and reinterpret the same room from different angles and micro-moments: close-up push-button oven, breakfast bar scene with housewife, and detail of teardrop refrigerator.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
